# Afia Dental Care

> Family and cosmetic dentistry in West Roxbury, MA, for over 40 years. Cleanings, same-day crowns, implants, Invisalign, pediatric care and same-day emergencies.

- Address: 1208B VFW Parkway, Suite 307, West Roxbury, MA 02132 (Ingleside Mall)
- Phone: (617) 325-4100
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9 am-5 pm, Sat 9 am-3 pm, Sun closed
- New-patient visit $139 (exam, cleaning, four digital X-rays); emergency exam $59
- Dentists: Dr. Raza Baig, DMD (restorative and cosmetic dentistry); Dr. Eriselda Bano (pediatric dentistry); Dr. Suky Sidhu (smile makeovers, invisalign and veneers); Dr. Natalie Sokoloff, DDS (general, restorative and preventive care)
- Book online: https://afiadentalcare.com/#book
